## PROBLEM
Release behavior is fragmented and hard to discover.
## SUCCESS
README is the longer maintainable primary guide for extensions, mandatory rules, tool policy, Python, ast-grep, and troubleshooting.
## SCOPE
Specialists README.md only; inspect docs and commits as evidence.
## NON_GOALS
Do not edit secondary docs or claim publication.
## CONSTRAINTS
SCRUTINY: high. Exact commands and null/[]/replace semantics. Include Alpine ast-grep limitation.
## LIBRARIES
N/A — documentation sync.
## VALIDATION
- [ ] Live CLI commands checked.
- [ ] No runtime-policy contradiction.
- [ ] README-first navigation is clear.
## OUTPUT
One README commit plus citation/drift report.
source.title: sync-docs: make Specialists README the canonical release guide
